name: Facet
text:
DO: Default to a single high-contrast dark theme with a persistent, one-click toggle to light mode.

A high-contrast dark theme sharpens visibility and reduces eye strain during long sessions, matching our goal of liveliness and clarity. The one-click toggle respects user preference without cluttering the interface, accepting the trade-off of slightly slower load times for the toggle’s assets. This keeps the design clean and consistent while giving users control, aligning with our quality-first approach.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A single high-contrast dark theme still locks out users who need light mode for accessibility or context—like editing screenshots or working in bright rooms. A persistent toggle risks inconsistency: users won’t reliably switch, and the interface will fragment into two half-baked modes. Settle it with user testing: measure task completion and comfort in both themes across roles.
